subject: Patho 1
description: Vascular and cellular events, mediators, outcomes, granulomas.

questions.text: Which cell type predominates in the inflammatory infiltrate during the first 6 to 24 hours of acute inflammation?
questions.explanation: Neutrophils predominate in the first 6 to 24 hours, followed by monocytes/macrophages at 24 to 48 hours.

questions.text: Which mediator is primarily responsible for the vasodilation and increased vascular permeability seen immediately after tissue injury?
questions.explanation: Histamine, released from mast cells, causes arteriolar dilation and venular endothelial contraction (immediate transient response). LTB4 and C5a are chemotactic.
